proposals.title: Report on Lobbying Activities
proposals.topic_summary: Requests annual report disclosing Pfizer's direct and indirect lobbying policies, payments, trade association and model-legislation organization memberships, and oversight processes.
proposals.evidence: the Board of Directors has recommended a vote AGAINST these proposals for broader policy reasons

proposals.title: Give Shareholders Final Say on Election of Directors
proposals.topic_summary: Requests policy that a director failing to obtain a majority vote (in uncontested elections) be removed immediately from the board.
proposals.evidence: it recommends a vote AGAINST this proposal

proposals.title: Right to Act by Written Consent
proposals.topic_summary: Requests steps to permit shareholders holding the minimum votes needed to authorize action to act by written consent.
proposals.evidence: recommends a vote AGAINST this proposal.

proposals.title: Certain Taxable Events
proposals.topic_summary: Requests that any taxable event for shareholders from a transaction also be borne by management and the Board of Directors.
proposals.evidence: recommends that shareholders vote AGAINST this proposal.
